component: Plant-centered LOSP initiating events at power
failureMode: Frequency per unit critical year, sustained events, industry
table: NUREG/CR-5496, Table 3-7. Event occurrence rates: means, percentiles, and distributions.
method: Gamma distribution whose uncertainty accounts for year-to-year variation beyond Poisson counts. table: NUREG/CR-5496, Table 3-7. Event occurrence rates: means, percentiles, and distributions.

failureMode: Sustained recovery time, fitted lognormal, industry
table: NUREG/CR-5496, Table 3-8. Fitted distributions of recovery times of sustained LOSP events: means, percentiles, and distributions.
method: Lognormal fitted to 102 site-averaged recovery times of 2 minutes or more, with mean 3.39 and standard deviation 1.435 of ln(minutes). Printed median 29.6 min, error factor 10.6, mean 82.9 min, and 5th and 95th percentiles 2.80 and 313.7 min. A normality test of ln(time) gave p-value 0.25. A slight upward time trend (p-value 0.03, a factor 3.6 on the median over 17 years) was found but not modeled. Converted from minutes to hours. Table B-8 repeats this row.

failureMode: Sustained recovery time, fitted lognormal, industry
table: NUREG/CR-5496, Table 3-8. Fitted distributions of recovery times of sustained LOSP events: means, percentiles, and distributions.
method: Lognormal fitted to only 4 site events with reported recovery times, two of which may be dependent. Uncertainty from lack of data is not accounted for, so results need care. Printed median 185 min, error factor 2.14, mean 206.5 min, and 5th and 95th percentiles 86.5 and 397.5 min. A normality test of ln(time) gave p-value 0.23. Converted from minutes to hours. Table B-8 repeats this row.

failureMode: Sustained recovery time, fitted lognormal, industry
table: NUREG/CR-5496, Table 3-8. Fitted distributions of recovery times of sustained LOSP events: means, percentiles, and distributions.
method: Lognormal fitted to 9 site events with reported recovery times, ignoring between-site differences. Printed median 341 min, error factor 14.7, mean 1295 min, and 5th and 95th percentiles 23.15 and 5009 min. A normality test of ln(time) gave p-value 0.59. Converted from minutes to hours. Table B-8 repeats this row.
